title: Retained corpus subtree binding
description: Portable fixity for one unchanged authored subtree. The operator selects its physical corpus root and exact revision separately. Membership uses tos-val-full-membership-v1; member_mode additionally binds every logical file mode. This binding grants no source admission, rights or publication.

scope.description: The native importer also checks the complete RelativePath grammar and refuses incoming members in this subtree.

restore_origin_git_commit.description: Exact Git witness from which this byte membership can be restored; the import itself verifies the separately selected corpus bytes.

member_mode.description: One uniform portable file mode, 0644 or 0755; object-pool files remain immutable 0444.
